title: Cold-to-thermal domination pays an extensive entropy factor
statement: For a commuting Pauli Hamiltonian with check weight<=w, qubit degree<=D and no unprotected qubit, disjoint syndrome neighborhoods give M>=N/[D(w-1)+1] and Z_syn>=(1+exp(-beta D))^M. The least rho_cold<=C rho_thermal factor is EXACTLY C=Z_syn. With an admissible iid-p write the factor is at least Z_syn(1-p)^N.
